title: The Cartographer's Fair Split
story: Gullowmere the Map Hoarder guards a chest of 1,000 silver marks stolen from the mapmakers' guild — but only if nobody can divide it fairly. Mr 6 flips the lid and finds a note: the treasure must go to 8 mapmakers, except the guild keeps 20% for new ink and parchment first.
question: How many silver marks does each mapmaker receive?
hint: Take the guild's 20% off the top first, then split what's left among the 8 mapmakers.
victory: Mr 6 counts out eight neat stacks of 100 and Gullowmere, who cannot bear a perfectly fair split, folds itself into a paper crane and flaps out the window.
imagePrompt: A hunched hoarder made of rolled parchment maps crouched over an open chest of silver in a lamplit guild hall, a number-six knight stacking coins into tidy piles.
solution: The guild takes 20% of the 1000 silver marks first: 0.20 × 1000 = 200 marks.
Split it among the 8 mapmakers: 800 ÷ 8 = 100 marks each.
praise: Splitting between the 8 mapmakers was exactly the right move — the guild's 20% just needed to come off the top first.
